title: 高盛闪辉地产还在调整：拖累却要变小，明年增长靠什么？
speaker: Wei Shan

segments.en: So as investors, it's just another set of uncertainties to navigate. Your report, less drag more uncertainty, walk us through that sort of headline of what are you expecting for next year for growth for China.
segments.zh: 所以对市场参与者来说，这不过是另一组需要应对的不确定性。你们的报告标题是“拖累减少，不确定性增加”，请带我们了解一下，你们对明年中国增长的主要预期是什么。

segments.en: So as you said, we're expecting pretty much a similar pace of growth next year.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，我们预计明年的增长速度与今年大致相似。

segments.en: Now, there's a little math behind it as I was getting a bit wonky, but what we are really trying to emphasize is that focus on the second derivative.
segments.zh: 这背后有一些数学计算，我有点过于技术化了，但我们真正想强调的是关注二阶导数。

segments.en: What that means is that yes, property is very weak and probably continue to decline, but the magnitude of decline next year should be smaller than this year.
segments.zh: 这意味着，是的，地产市场非常疲软，可能还会继续下行，但明年下行的幅度应该小于今年。

segments.en: Same thing with the fiscal tightening. There's a whole year if you look at China's tax collection up, government expenditure down, that's the fiscal tightening, fiscal consolidation, right?
segments.zh: 财政紧缩也是同样的情况。如果你看中国全年税收增加、政府支出下降，那就是财政紧缩、财政整顿，对吧？

segments.en: So we expect to continue to tight fiscal policy, but you're not going to see this big, ginormous step in tightening, the pace will slow.
segments.zh: 所以我们预计财政政策将继续偏紧，但不会看到大幅度的紧缩步伐，节奏会放缓。

segments.en: So the second derivative is the turning positive. In other words, if this year fiscal policy subtracted growth, let's say by one percent of the next year is a half a percent, that's a positive on the sequential basis.
segments.zh: 所以二阶导数正在转正。换句话说，如果今年财政政策拖累增长，比如一个百分点，明年是半个百分点，那在环比基础上就是正向的。

segments.en: So if you're thinking for and a half for next year, I mean, do you still see any sort of urgency from policy makers to inject sort of any stimulus at this point, or are they still going to expect the pillars like exports to continue things for?
segments.zh: 所以如果你考虑明年增长4.5%，我的意思是，你认为政策制定者现在还有紧迫感去注入刺激措施吗，还是他们仍然指望出口等支柱继续支撑？
